name: Closed-Form Color Estimation (CF) Loss
definition: A regularization method that breaks the entanglement of density and color fields in radiance fields by estimating the color field given a density field and posed training images, then using the photometric loss from this estimated field to supervise the density field.
summary: Closed-Form Color Estimation Loss is a regularization technique that breaks density-color entanglement by estimating a closed-form color field to supervise density, distinguishing objects from background where distortion loss fails.
